heal_pokemon_center.description: Executes a precise, auto-advance-safe sequence of button presses and sleeps to heal our team with Nurse Joy at the Pokémon Center, completely bypassing the harness's automatic text advance.

history.commit_message: Fixed consecutive sleep error by combining them into a single sleep 7500 action.

route3_grind_loop.description: Encapsulates a 10-step overworld grinding loop on Row 9 and Row 10 in the Route 3 tall grass to trigger a wild encounter. Returns an array of buttons: ['Up', 'Right', 'Right', 'Right', 'Right', 'Down', 'Left', 'Left', 'Left', 'Left'].

history.commit_message: Define the 10-step overworld grinding loop for Route 3 tall grass.
